title: WaterCastle | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Carriage House And Community Pool- WaterCastle By Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: WaterCastle by Royal Destinations Location: WaterColor Address: 115 Mystic Cobalt Details: Tucked in the heart of WaterColor, WaterCastle is a charming two-story cottage-style home and the perfect destination for your next family getaway. Its prime location places you moments from the WaterColor Beach Club and the shimmering emerald waters of scenic 30A. This 5-bedroom, 5.5-bath home offers the ideal blend of comfort and style, surrounded by screened porches and a courtyard perfect for grilling, dining, and relaxing together. The second floor features an open-concept kitchen, living, and dining area — a bright, welcoming space where everyone can gather and unwind. Located near Camp WaterColor, it’s easy for little ones to explore, play in the nearby parks, ride bikes (four are included!), or go fishing close by. Whether you’re making s’mores in the courtyard or biking to the beach, WaterCastle is where family memories are made to last a lifetime. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -4 minute walk to Beach Access -2 Parking Spaces: One inside the garage and the other on the backside of the garage. -9 Dining Accommodations: -Coffee Maker Available -*This home has a 6-seater LSV (Low Speed Vehicle) on site for only $600/week. LSVs (Low Speed Vehicles) are the best way to get around the Watercolor Community! Please contact Reservations to add this amenity to your stay!! WaterColor Neighborhood Highlights: -Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S. -WaterColor provides a free, on-demand trolley for guests, available daily with seasonal hours through the WaterColor Trolley app. For more information, contact our Reservations Team. -A 499-Acre Coastal Resort and Residential Community -Bike Community -Award-Winning Tennis Facilities -Beachside, Poolside and Lakeside Dining -Nearby State Parks and Preserves -4 Swimming Pools Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 14 5 Beds / 5.5 Baths First Floor: Guest Bedroom 1: Queen Bed, Ensuite Bath Guest Bedroom 2: Queen Bed: Ensuite Bath Bunk Room 3: Two Twin over Twin Bunks: Private Bath -Laundry Room Second Floor: Master Bedroom 4: King Bed, Full Private Ensuite Bath Kitchen / Dining Area / Living Room/Half Bath Carriage House: Bunk Room 5: Full over Full Bunk, additional Full Bed & Bathroom Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes Please Note: *Nearby construction is underway. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *The jets in the jetted tubs are not operational. Home Sweet Home: A Note From The Homeowner- We bought WaterCastle with another family years ago and couldn’t be happier! From the moment we stepped inside, it felt like it was meant for us. It’s the kind of place where the pace slows, and fun starts right away. The location is perfect—just a short walk to the beach, Beach Club, and biking trails. We love being close to restaurants and shopping, especially the Wine Bar for pizza and drinks, with The Candy Shop next door for the kids. The Boathouse Pool and marina are around the corner, offering paddleboarding, sunsets, and pool time. We also enjoy taking the bikes or golf cart to Camp WaterColor, the tennis and pickleball courts, or Seaside. Inside, we’ve created spots that fit our rhythm—ping pong in the garage, porch hangs, game nights, and lazy breakfasts at the kitchen island. The house had charm from day one, and over time, we’ve made it our own. The neighborhood is friendly, laid-back, and full of people who love it here. WaterCastle is our place to reconnect, relax, and create lasting memories.
